_comment: Видео опытов для ХимЛаба (Лаборатория → «Эффектные опыты», и подсказки к ОГЭ 12, 17, 23, ЕГЭ 24). Полный промпт = prompt опыта + style + avoid. Файл видео класть в app/static/video/chem/<id>.mp4 (имя = id). Химия в описании выверена: цвет осадка, газ, скорость — как в задачах сайта; если модель нарисовала другой цвет — перегенерировать, а не оставлять.
style: STYLE: realistic close-up video of a school chemistry experiment, filmed like a clean educational lab demo. Clear glass test tube (or small beaker when stated) held in a test-tube rack on a clean white lab bench, plain light-grey background, soft even daylight from the left, shallow depth of field, static tripod camera with a very slow gentle push-in, 6 seconds, 16:9, 1080p, true-to-life colours of chemicals, liquid fills about one third of the tube, a gloved hand with a dropper or tongs appears only to add the reagent and then leaves the frame, the result stays clearly visible in the last 2 seconds
avoid: NEGATIVE: no text, no letters or labels on glassware, no logos, no faces, no people beyond one gloved hand, no explosions, no fire or flame unless the description asks for it, no smoke or fumes unless described, no glowing or neon liquids, no colour changes other than the ones described, no extra tubes in focus, no cartoon look, no slow-motion splashing

items.title: Голубой осадок гидроксида меди(II)
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear light-blue copper sulfate solution. A dropper adds a few drops of a colourless sodium hydroxide solution. Where the drops fall, a bright blue gelatinous jelly-like precipitate instantly forms and spreads as loose blue flakes through the liquid, the liquid around them stays pale blue.

items.title: Бурый осадок гидроксида железа(III)
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear yellow-orange iron(III) chloride solution. A dropper adds colourless sodium hydroxide solution. A rusty red-brown flocculent precipitate forms immediately and fills the lower half of the tube with brown fluffy flakes.

items.title: Серо-зелёный осадок гидроксида железа(II)
items.observe: образование серо-зелёного осадка, который буреет на воздухе
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear very pale green iron(II) sulfate solution. A dropper adds colourless sodium hydroxide solution. A dull grey-green swampy precipitate forms; during the last seconds its top surface, touching the air, slowly turns slightly brownish.

items.title: Белый осадок сульфата бария
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear colourless barium chloride solution. A dropper adds clear colourless sodium sulfate solution. A dense milky-white fine precipitate appears at once, the liquid turns opaque white like milk, then the white powder slowly begins to settle to the bottom.

items.title: Белый творожистый осадок хлорида серебра
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear colourless silver nitrate solution. A dropper adds clear colourless sodium chloride solution. A white curdy cheese-like precipitate forms in clumps that look like cottage cheese and slowly sink.

items.title: Светло-жёлтый осадок бромида серебра
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear colourless silver nitrate solution. A dropper adds clear colourless potassium bromide solution. A pale cream-yellow curdy precipitate forms, noticeably slightly yellowish compared with pure white.

items.title: Жёлтый осадок иодида серебра
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear colourless silver nitrate solution. A dropper adds clear colourless potassium iodide solution. A distinctly yellow cloudy precipitate forms and fills the liquid with yellow suspension.

items.title: Белый осадок карбоната кальция
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear colourless calcium chloride solution. A dropper adds clear colourless sodium carbonate solution. A white fine precipitate forms, the liquid becomes cloudy white.

items.title: Газ из карбоната и кислоты
items.observe: выделение газа без цвета и запаха
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear colourless sodium carbonate solution. A dropper adds clear colourless hydrochloric acid. The liquid immediately fizzes vigorously with many small colourless gas bubbles rising and a short layer of foam at the surface, like opening sparkling water; no colour change.

items.title: Цинк в соляной кислоте
items.prompt: A test tube with clear colourless hydrochloric acid. Tongs drop two small grey zinc granules into it. A steady stream of small colourless gas bubbles forms on the surface of the zinc granules and rises continuously; the liquid stays colourless.

items.title: Магний в соляной кислоте
items.prompt: A test tube with clear colourless hydrochloric acid. Tongs drop a short shiny strip of magnesium ribbon into it. Very vigorous fizzing with many colourless bubbles, the ribbon floats and visibly shrinks and dissolves within seconds; the liquid stays colourless.

items.title: Медь в соляной кислоте — реакции нет
items.prompt: A test tube with clear colourless hydrochloric acid. Tongs drop a piece of shiny reddish copper wire into it. Nothing happens: no bubbles, no colour change, the copper stays shiny at the bottom for the whole clip.

items.title: Железный гвоздь в растворе медного купороса
items.prompt: A small glass beaker with a clear blue copper sulfate solution. A clean grey iron nail is lowered into it on a thread. Time-lapse feel: the immersed part of the nail gradually becomes covered with a reddish-brown copper coating, while the blue of the solution becomes slightly paler.

items.title: Растворение гидроксида меди(II) в кислоте
items.prompt: A test tube with a bright blue gelatinous copper(II) hydroxide precipitate in water. A dropper adds clear colourless hydrochloric acid. The blue precipitate dissolves and disappears, leaving a clear transparent blue-green solution without any solid.

items.title: Фенолфталеин: щёлочь и нейтрализация
items.prompt: A test tube with a clear colourless sodium hydroxide solution. A dropper adds two drops of colourless phenolphthalein indicator: the liquid turns bright raspberry-crimson. Then colourless hydrochloric acid is added drop by drop and the crimson colour fades until the liquid is fully colourless again.

items.title: Лакмус в кислоте
items.prompt: A test tube with clear colourless hydrochloric acid. A dropper adds a few drops of violet litmus solution. The violet colour immediately turns clear red throughout the liquid.

items.title: Метилоранж в кислоте и в щёлочи
items.observe: розово-красный в кислоте, жёлтый в щёлочи
items.prompt: Two test tubes side by side in a rack. Left tube contains colourless hydrochloric acid, right tube contains colourless sodium hydroxide solution. A dropper adds a few drops of orange methyl orange indicator to each: the left liquid turns pink-red, the right liquid turns clear yellow.

items.title: Обнаружение иона аммония
items.prompt: A test tube with a colourless mixture of ammonium chloride and sodium hydroxide solutions is gently warmed over a small spirit-lamp flame held by a tube holder. A strip of moist red litmus paper is held at the mouth of the tube without touching it: the paper slowly turns blue. No visible gas, no smoke.

items.title: Горение магния
items.prompt: Metal crucible tongs hold a strip of magnesium ribbon over a heat-resistant ceramic mat; its tip is touched to a spirit-lamp flame. The ribbon ignites and burns with an extremely bright blinding white light, leaving white powdery magnesium oxide ash. Camera exposure adapts so the flame is not a pure white blob. Fire is allowed in this clip.

items.title: Окраска пламени: натрий
items.prompt: A nichrome wire loop with a sodium salt is placed into the nearly colourless blue flame of a gas burner in a dim lab. The flame immediately becomes bright intense yellow-orange. Fire is allowed in this clip.

items.title: Окраска пламени: калий
items.prompt: A nichrome wire loop with a potassium salt is placed into the nearly colourless blue flame of a gas burner in a dim lab. The flame becomes pale lilac-violet. Fire is allowed in this clip.

items.title: Окраска пламени: литий
items.prompt: A nichrome wire loop with a lithium salt is placed into the nearly colourless blue flame of a gas burner in a dim lab. The flame becomes deep carmine red. Fire is allowed in this clip.

items.title: Окраска пламени: кальций
items.prompt: A nichrome wire loop with a calcium salt is placed into the nearly colourless blue flame of a gas burner in a dim lab. The flame becomes brick-red orange-red. Fire is allowed in this clip.

items.title: Окраска пламени: медь
items.prompt: A nichrome wire loop with a copper salt is placed into the nearly colourless blue flame of a gas burner in a dim lab. The flame becomes bright blue-green emerald. Fire is allowed in this clip.

items.title: Окраска пламени: барий
items.prompt: A nichrome wire loop with a barium salt is placed into the nearly colourless blue flame of a gas burner in a dim lab. The flame becomes pale yellow-green. Fire is allowed in this clip.

items.title: Амфотерность гидроксида цинка
items.observe: белый осадок растворяется в избытке щёлочи
items.prompt: A test tube with clear colourless zinc sulfate solution. A dropper adds colourless sodium hydroxide solution a little at a time: first a white gelatinous precipitate forms; as more sodium hydroxide is added, the white precipitate dissolves completely and the liquid becomes clear and colourless again.

items.title: Алюминий в растворе щёлочи
items.prompt: A test tube with clear colourless sodium hydroxide solution. Tongs drop a small crumpled piece of shiny aluminium foil into it. For the first two seconds nothing happens, then more and more colourless gas bubbles appear on the foil and the fizzing becomes steady.

items.title: Медь и концентрированная азотная кислота
items.prompt: Inside a laboratory fume hood with the glass sash partly lowered, a small piece of copper is dropped into a test tube with a small amount of colourless concentrated nitric acid. A dense reddish-brown gas immediately forms and fills the upper part of the tube, the liquid turns green and then blue-green. Visible brown fumes are allowed in this clip.

items.title: Иод и крахмал
items.prompt: A test tube with a cloudy-white starch paste diluted in water. A dropper adds one drop of brown iodine solution. Where the drop falls, an intense deep blue-black colour appears and quickly spreads through the whole liquid.

items.title: Реакция серебряного зеркала
items.prompt: A clean test tube with a colourless solution is warmed in a small beaker of hot water. Gradually the inner glass wall darkens and becomes coated with a shiny silver mirror layer, until the tube looks like a mirror reflecting the lab. No flame.

items.title: Глицерин и гидроксид меди(II)
items.prompt: A test tube with a freshly made pale blue copper(II) hydroxide precipitate in water. A dropper adds a few drops of clear viscous glycerol and the tube is gently shaken. The blue precipitate dissolves and the liquid becomes a clear, intense deep royal-blue solution.

items.title: Обесцвечивание бромной воды
items.prompt: A test tube with clear orange-yellow bromine water. A gas delivery tube bubbles a colourless gas through it. The orange colour fades steadily until the liquid is completely colourless.
